## Featured Projects

### 1. gladeshell (Flagship Open-Source Project)
- **Description:** An open-source, ultra-high-performance pure Rust (2024 edition) shell environment, prompt kit, and developer suite delivering 0.0114 ms (11.4 µs) prompt latency (~210x faster than Starship).
- **Key Architecture:** Zero-subshell forks, pure Rust Gitoxide (gix 0.88), native Ratatui TUI developer applications (Todo, Notes, Process Monitor), Rayon parallel multi-core compression, 24-in-1 FFmedia multimedia suite, and hardened AES-256-GCM vault with RAM zeroization.
- **License:** MIT License (100% Free & Open Source)
- **Repository:** https://github.com/rihadjahanopu/gladeshell
- **Live Website:** https://gladeshell.netlify.app
- **Case Study:** https://www.rihadjahanopu.com/projects/4

### 2. Digital Life Lessons
- **Description:** Interactive educational platform offering structured learning modules, rich-text student note editor, user dashboards, and Stripe checkout payments.
- **Tech Stack:** Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, MongoDB, Stripe.
- **Live Demo:** https://life-lesson-client.vercel.app/
- **Repository:** https://github.com/rihadjahanopu/life-lesson-client
- **Case Study:** https://www.rihadjahanopu.com/projects/1

### 3. MarketPlace Buy & Sell
- **Description:** Full-featured modern e-commerce platform with real-time inventory, accessible Radix UI components, and cart state synchronization via Redux Toolkit.
- **Tech Stack:** React, Redux Toolkit, Node.js, Express, Radix UI, Tailwind CSS.
- **Live Demo:** https://marketplace-client-bay.vercel.app/
- **Repository:** https://github.com/rihadjahanopu/marketplace-client
- **Case Study:** https://www.rihadjahanopu.com/projects/2

### 4. Nexus AI
- **Description:** Intelligent project management workspace combining Kanban project workflows with an embedded Agentic AI chat assistant powered by Google Gemini API.
- **Tech Stack:** Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Google Gemini API.
- **Live Demo:** https://nexes-ai-client.vercel.app/
- **Repository:** https://github.com/rihadjahanopu/nexes-ai-client
- **Case Study:** https://www.rihadjahanopu.com/projects/3
